translations.web: We will triumph in your salvation. In the name of our God, we will set up our banners. May Yahweh grant all your requests.
translations.bsb: May we shout for joy at your victory and raise a banner in the name of our God. May the LORD grant all your petitions.
translations.kjv: We will rejoice in thy salvation, and in the name of our God we will set up our banners: the LORD fulfil all thy petitions.
translations.asv: We will triumph in thy salvation, And in the name of our God we will set up our banners: Jehovah fulfil all thy petitions.
